zh: 我是在这个小区长大的，对这里很有感情。
old_en: I grew up in this neighborhood and feel very attached to it.
new_en: I grew up in this community and feel very attached to it.

zh: 孩子在乡下长大，性格很开朗。
old_en: The child grows up in the countryside and is very outgoing.
new_en: The child grew up in the countryside and has a cheerful personality.

zh: 因为父母的支持，我才能顺利长大。
old_en: Thanks to my parents' support, I was able to grow up smoothly.
new_en: Thanks to my parents' support, I was able to grow up well.

zh: 长大以后，我才明白父母的辛苦。
old_en: After I grew up, I finally understood how hard my parents worked.
new_en: Only after growing up did I understand how hard my parents worked.
